tips.text: Run Saya's Visions on normal, not Steel Path; the Oni takes two to three times as long for a few extra pearls.
Hold two offerings through the Extermination stage, one in your Warframe and one as Operator, and deliver both the moment the Oni goes invulnerable.
Bring an area-control frame such as Khora, Gara, Vauban or Zephyr; the offering timer only runs while enemies stand in the circle.
Keep a pearl tally and buy missing blueprints late; one you buy and then drop is wasted pearls.
Play public; the node stays populated and others often run the offerings.
Void sling between the offering points and the shrine instead of running.
Kill Leapers and Ospreys quickly; they dodge ground-effect abilities and keep the offering timer paused.
Destroy the Undying Flyers' pods, which pause the offering timer.
Deliver an offering only when the objective asks for one; otherwise it gives a random buff and does not advance the mission.
Do not rely on ability nukes or Viral on the Oni; it is immune to most abilities and caps status stacking.
On Steel Path, strip the Oni's armor with a non-ability source such as Latron Incarnon's Flensing Spikes.
Skip the Duviri Circuit for Koumei; she is not in its rotation, so Saya's Visions is the only part source.
Plan for two full sets if you want a Helminth copy; it roughly doubles everything.
Expect about an hour for the frame alone and three to four hours with both signature weapons.
Players hold this farm up as the model for how a frame farm should work, even if the mission feels tedious.
